title: A Roadmap Towards Omnichannel Transformation in Supply Chains: A Technological Perspective
content: Consumers increasingly seek a seamless experience across available channels. To respond to this emerging demand, grocery retailers are shifting to an Omnichannel Model. This paper aims to identify the main enablers and challenges of omnichannel transformation. The study uses a multiple-case study methodology and selects cases from different countries. It also relies on a robust theoretical framework linking Complex Adaptive System (CAS) theory, the Dynamic Capabilities View (DCV), and Real Option Theory (ROT). The study offers a roadmap for decision-makers and proposes solutions for potential challenges when transitioning to an omnichannel strategy. Findings show that digital readiness is a crucial condition for such transformation. It also addresses strategic partnerships and the optimal conditions for integration. Results also highlight top management support and data management and analytics as the main capabilities driving the change. The study also showed that the omnichannel system functions as a CAS, relying on dynamic capabilities grounded in ROT principles to enable the transition to the omnichannel model and sustain value creation.
